support.message: North America enterprise workspace: We found duplicate subscription charges and several users cannot sign in. We need a refund, an incident update and a guaranteed resolution time before our launch. Which steps can your support team take?
support.policy:
Duplicate charges are eligible for refund after billing verifies the duplicate transaction. Refunds must be approved by a billing specialist. Do not promise a processing date until the transaction is verified.
Billing verification requires the transaction ID, billing date and workspace ID.
Account access incidents must be separated from billing tickets and escalated to the on-call engineer.
Support cannot promise a resolution time or reimbursement outside the documented refund policy.
Do not request passwords, full payment-card numbers or authentication tokens.
The first response should acknowledge both problems and state the next action for each.
The workspace owner must approve subscription cancellation; a refund request is not cancellation.
For duplicate charges, retain one active subscription unless the owner separately requests cancellation.
Regional support staff can collect evidence but only billing specialists approve money movement.
Provide a concise summary to the escalation team with affected users and timestamps.
Confirm whether the issue affects the whole workspace or only one user before suggesting recovery steps.
